card.name: Word after a question opener
card.fires_on: The word right after a question word such as who, why, when, where or will, often a verb or a 'this' that starts the question's subject. Also a few other spots inside questions or instructions.

modes.label: Verb after question word

modes.example: Will<< this>> eventually turn into Alzheimer's disease? DR
